versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the BytePlus MediaKit Video Highlights skill.
- Generates and queries football highlight reels from one or more video URLs, using BytePlus/MediaKit’s video-highlights-llm tool.
- Defaults to football-specific presets and a 60-second highlight if not specified.
- Supports custom scoring and analysis prompts for highlight customization.
- Enforces API limits: up to 3 hours per video, 15 hours total input.
- Provides clear usage workflow and environment variable-based API authentication.
